verdict.rationale: Apify's own docs describe rotating datacenter and residential IPs to avoid blocking, and a SessionPool that handles proxy IP rotation, with support for Apify Proxy, your own proxies, or third-party proxies. That is direct proxy-rotation support for anti-bot evasion. The evidence does not show automatic retry triggered by block detection, nor escalation through an ordered chain of different proxy types; the client retry docs cover API request retries, not scraping proxy fallback. missing for 10: documented automatic retry-on-block behavior, tiered/chained proxy fallback (e.g. datacenter→residential escalation), block-detection triggers, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can automatically retry through a chain of different proxies when anti-bot detection blocks a request

citations.quote: Avoid blocking by smartly rotating datacenter and residential IP addresses.
SessionPool is a class that allows you to handle the rotation of proxy IP addresses along with cookies and other custom settings in Apify SDK.
you can use your own proxy servers, proxy servers acquired from third-party providers, or you can rely on Apify Proxy for your scraping needs.
